reason: E1 supports the existence of metastable solid-solution states in Mg-containing HEAs. E2 directly supports that fine intermetallics promote a protective film and high corrosion resistance. However, no cited evidence supports the later-stage coarsening into detrimental interconnected networks or the associated loss of resistance; this part of the mechanism is unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Mg-containing HEAs can be prepared in a metastable solid-solution state
Fine intermetallic precipitates promote a protective surface film and enhance corrosion resistance
Extended exposure leads to precipitate coarsening and interconnected networks
Coarsened intermetallic networks disrupt the oxide film and create micro-galvanic sites, reducing resistance
